page_title: BRA 3-0 HAI | Brazil v Haiti 20/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Rayan (Brazil) tackles a bit over-zealously and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
90+4' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jean-Kevin Duverne (Haiti) heads on.
90+4' The linesman makes the right call and Haiti will have a corner.

90+3' A neat pass finds Dominique Simon (Haiti) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the left side of the goal, but Alisson denies him with a good save.
90+2' Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul after Ricardo Ade (Haiti) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+1' Good chance! Ederson (Brazil) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Louicius Deedson (Haiti) is adjudged offside.
89' Ricardo Ade (Haiti) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the left post.
88' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Louicius Deedson (Haiti) takes it short.

87' Wilson Isidor (Haiti) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save. The ball goes out of play. Haiti are awarded a corner kick.
86' Martin Experience (Haiti) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Hernandez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
86' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Haiti) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Martin Experience (Haiti) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
82' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle. Ederson (Brazil) commits a foul after dangerous play.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Derrick Etienne (Haiti) is brought on as a substitute for Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.
81' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Ederson (Brazil) replaces Bruno Guimaraes.
81' Substitution. Danilo Santos (Brazil) replaces Vinicius Junior.
79' Ricardo Ade (Haiti) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
78' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Endrick (Brazil) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
77' Martin Experience (Haiti) trips an opposition player and Alejandro Hernandez signals a foul.
76' Douglas Santos (Brazil) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
75' Lenny Joseph (Haiti) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Alejandro Hernandez who sees an offensive foul.
74' Rayan (Brazil) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Hernandez signals a foul.
73' Endrick (Brazil) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
73' The attendance is 68324.
72' Danley Jean Jacques (Haiti) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
71' It's time for a substitution. Lenny Joseph (Haiti) comes on in place of Ruben Providence.

68' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
66' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Haiti) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the left post.
65' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Douglas Santos (Brazil) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
65' Douglas Santos (Brazil) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
64' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Endrick (Brazil) replacing Matheus Cunha.
64' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Lucas Paqueta and he is replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil).
63' Ricardo Ade (Haiti) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
62' Substitution. Louicius Deedson (Haiti) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Josue Casimir walks off.
62' The ball goes out for a corner. Haiti can continue in their attacking effort.
62' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
61' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Danilo (Brazil).

57' Dominique Simon (Haiti) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
56' One of the Haiti players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
53' Douglas Santos (Brazil) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.

45+4' Frantzdy Pierrot (Haiti) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
45+3' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Lucas Paqueta laid the ball off to Vinicius Junior (Brazil), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
45+2' Casemiro (Brazil) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
44' Josue Casimir (Haiti) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
42' Josue Casimir (Haiti) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

36' 2 - 0 Vinicius Junior feeds the ball through to Matheus Cunha (Brazil), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:0!
34' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
31' Dangerous play by Raphinha (Brazil). Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
31' The game is interrupted as Vinicius Junior (Brazil) is flagged offside.
29' A pass finds the feet of Raphinha (Brazil) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
27' The referee blows for a cooling break.
26' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Alejandro Hernandez to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Brazil players can finally celebrate.
25' The Brazil players halt their celebrations as referee Alejandro Hernandez makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Matheus Cunha (Brazil) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:0.

23' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) unleashes a promising shot towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Johny Placide thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
22' Raphinha (Brazil) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
22' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Raphinha (Brazil). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
22' Danilo (Brazil) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Brazil will take a corner.
21' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
19' The linesman signals that Carlens Arcus (Haiti) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
18' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Raphinha (Brazil), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

17' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Brazil have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
17' Raphinha (Brazil) sends the corner into the box, but Johny Placide intercepts it and averts the threat.
14' Danilo (Brazil) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Hernandez no option but to blow his whistle.
13' The linesman raises his flag. Danilo (Brazil) is adjudged offside.

6' Raphinha (Brazil) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
4' Matheus Cunha (Brazil) is caught offside!
4' Carlens Arcus (Haiti) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
